desc: Derive and document the combinatorial formula C(n-1, k) * m * (m-1)^(n-1-k) modulo 1e9+7.
Implement modular exponentiation for computing (m-1)^(n-1-k) efficiently.
Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to n-1 to compute combinations in O(1) after O(n) preprocessing.
Combine the components in countGoodArrays and apply modulo operations at each multiplication step.
Add edge-case handling for m=1, n=1, and k=0 to ensure correct behavior with zero bases and zero exponents.
Validate the implementation against the provided examples and a few additional small brute-force cases.
